title: `os start` with no project, the docs' one-line Community quickstart, warns that the platform's own empty-kernel stub `com.objectstack.empty` declares no engines.protocol range
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYMkB4dbaYNKufhvBr

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named landing point. Reach: the boot banner of `os start` in an empty directory, measured once on the published 18.3.0 CLI.
Business reason: docs.objectos.ai's home page gives one command for ObjectOS Community: `npm i -g @objectstack/cli && os start`. Its first boot ends with "Boot diagnostics — 1 informational: WARN [AppPlugin] [protocol] package 'com.objectstack.empty' declares no engines.protocol range; loading under protocol 18.0.0 without a compatibility check (ADR-0087)." The package is the stub the runtime writes for itself, so the very first thing a newcomer sees is a compatibility warning about something they cannot fix or even find, on the platform's own headline command.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:server` / runtime implementer in `packages/runtime/src/default-host.ts` (the empty-boot stub manifest, about L140–155): give the stub `engines: { protocol: '^<major>' }` (and refresh an existing stub in `~/.objectstack/dist/objectstack.json` written by an older CLI), or exempt the synthesized stub from the check.
Duplicate search (incl. closed): `"declares no engines.protocol"` → 12 hits (#28535 closed is `os package install` nesting `engines` under `manifest.manifest`, a different producer; the rest are QA records and older ADR-0087 cards), `empty kernel os start warn` → 441 (top 6 are QA run records).

QA-source: post-release 18.3.0 newcomer walkthrough, docs.objectos.ai Community Path A, anchor #27377

## Reproduction (published @objectstack/cli 18.3.0, Node 22.23.4, npm 10.9.9, empty `HOME`, empty working directory)
1. `npm i -g @objectstack/cli` (exit 0, 64 s).
2. `os start`.

Observed: banner "Artifact: none (empty kernel — install apps via the Console marketplace)", then the WARN above under Boot diagnostics. `~/.objectstack/dist/objectstack.json` holds `manifest.id: com.objectstack.empty` with no `engines`.

Expected: the empty kernel boots with no protocol-compatibility warning about its own stub.
